description:
Rename the name at AT to NEW-NAME wherever the language server finds it.
The server is asked first what is renamed at AT, where it says (as
Eglot's prepareRename); renamed by the same server, where the name is
then. With NAME, refused unless it is still the name there. From keys,
AT is point, NAME the name there, and NEW-NAME is read, the old name
(as the server says it) to edit.

name.description: The name expected at AT, refused if another is there now; "" for any.

name: lsp-rename

description:
Set the option NAME to VALUE in BUFFER, or with GLOBAL everywhere.
From keys, NAME and VALUE are read, BUFFER is this one, and a prefix
argument makes it GLOBAL.

buffer.description: The buffer it is set in, unless globally.

global.description: Whether it is set globally rather than in BUFFER.

value.description: Its value: of the option's type.

name: set-option
